subject: Coordination: Order Form redlines — net terms split, escrow holdback & VAT flow
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@clarityhealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clarityhealth.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redlines to order form (CL-9843) + tax evidence

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are our redlines to the Order Form and a copy of our tax residency certificate. Key asks from our side:

- Split invoicing between service fees (monthly runtime) and professional services so we can apply different net terms (vendor policy).
- Escrow/holdback: we propose a 5% holdback on the first two invoices until milestone 2 (integration complete).
- VAT handling: ClarityHealth is VAT registered; we expect Redwood to invoice gross with VAT applied — or confirm if Redwood can zero-rate with our VAT certificate.
- Minimum commit: we'd like to phase the agreed commit into two tranches (60% upfront, 40% after go-live).

We attached: Order_Form_CL-9843_v3_redlines.docx (redline) and Clarity_Tax_Residence_Certificate.pdf.

Can you confirm who on Redwood legal/finance should review the tax certificate and escrow language? Also need PO instructions for invoicing routing and final remit address for ACH.

Appreciate a quick turn — our procurement window closes this week.

Thanks,
Maria
Procurement Manager, ClarityHealth

Maria — thanks for sending and for the clear summary. Looping in Ben (lead AE) for commercial alignment and Kimberly/Laura for legal/finance review.

Quick notes from our side:
- We can support split invoicing; need to confirm whether your AP requires separate invoices per line-item or a single invoice with tax breakdown.
- Escrow/holdback: Ben, Kimberly — can you weigh in on 5% holdback tied to milestone 2? Our standard is to avoid escrow but we can consider a short holdback tied to acceptance criteria.
- Net terms: Clarity requested different net terms per line — we usually treat the order form net term globally but can agree to a services-only net45 if needed.

Kimberly/Laura — attached redline is the source of truth; please advise on (1) escrow/holdback language and (2) VAT evidence workflow (we need to determine if zero-rate is acceptable or if Redwood should invoice with VAT).

Maria — will aim to get a full response by EOD tomorrow. If easier, Ben can coordinate a 20-min call to close commercial points today.

— Logan

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redlines to order form (CL-9843) + tax evidence

Hi all,

Thanks — reviewed the attached redlines. Summary of legal/finance position and suggested language:

1) Escrow / Holdback
- We are open to a temporary holdback but prefer a defined holdback clause rather than a true third-party escrow, e.g.:
  "Buyer may withhold up to 5% of the invoiced amount for the first two invoices, to be released upon satisfactory completion of Milestone 2 (Integration Acceptance). Any disputes regarding acceptance shall be escalated per Section 8 (Dispute Resolution)."
- Rationale: avoids third-party agent and reduces operational friction.

2) Net terms split by bucket
- Commercially acceptable to have two invoicing buckets: (a) Recurring Usage (net30), (b) Professional Services (net45).
- Implementation detail: single invoice may be used if line items clearly mark bucket and due dates; otherwise two invoices is simplest for AP.

3) VAT / Tax evidence
- If Clarity provides a valid VAT registration/residence certificate (we received the PDF), Redwood can *attempt* to zero-rate eligible transactions, but we need Finance to validate by jurisdiction. For US-headquartered Redwood, many services are taxable; for EU/ROW we may zero-rate if evidence valid.
- Request: Procurement should add a clause: "Buyer shall provide tax residency/registration evidence at least 5 business days prior to first invoice; failure to provide will require Seller to apply VAT and Buyer to seek reclaim per local law."

4) PO & Invoice routing
- Require a PO number on each invoice and the remit details (ACH instructions) in the Order Form appendix.

5) Minimum commit tranching
- We can accept a two-tranche commit (60/40) provided the MRR/usage baseline is met and there's a crediting mechanism if usage exceeds commit. Suggest language for crediting on overage/under-utilization.

Next steps (proposed):
- Ben to confirm commercial acceptability of the two-tranche commit and proposed net terms.
- Finance (Laura) to validate VAT zero-rate feasibility for Clarity's jurisdictions.
- Logan to schedule a 15-min sync with Clarity if they want to close today.

I've added suggested redline snippets into the review doc (internal). If we agree I can draft the final Order Form language to present to Clarity.

— Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: internal redline snippets

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gomez <m.gomez@clarityhealth.com>, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redlines to order form (CL-9843) + tax evidence

Maria — appreciate the clear asks. Commercial proposal from Redwood:

- Commit tranching: Accept 60% / 40% split. We will apply 60% of the annual commit to the first invoice(s) on contract start, with the remaining 40% invoiced at go-live.
- Holdback: We are OK with a 5% holdback on the first two invoices, to be released upon Milestone 2 acceptance; crediting on final invoice if holdback is not applied.
- Net terms: We can do Recurring Usage net30 and Professional Services net45. If your AP requires, we will produce separate invoices per bucket.
- VAT: We'll attempt zero-rating where law permits; if not, Redwood will invoice VAT and Clarity may reclaim per local process. We need your AP contact to confirm how they prefer to receive tax evidence (email to finance@clarityhealth.com or upload to DocuSign packet).

Operational ask: Please provide the PO number and remit address for ACH + your AP contact. If you can accept, Logan and I will finalize an Order Form redline reflecting the agreed commercial bullets and send for signature.

If helpful, let's do a 20-min call at 1:00 PM PT today to close outstanding items — I can include Finance (Laura) and Kimberly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
